{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Remove QA orders: revenue == '999,999.99'
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != '999,999.99']

# Convert revenue to float
df_clean['revenue'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop refunded orders
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Focus on converted == 1
df_converted = df_clean[df_clean['converted'] == 1]

# Now, exclude rows where customer_age == -1 (missing data)
df_converted_valid = df_converted[df_converted['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age of valid converted customers
mean_age_valid = df_converted_valid['customer_age'].mean()

# Print all required values
print("Total converted customers (converted == 1) after removing QA and refunded: ", len(df_converted))
print("Converted customers with age -1: ", (df_converted['customer_age'] == -1).sum())
print("Converted customers with valid age (age != -1): ", len(df_converted_valid))
print("Mean age of valid converted customers: ", mean_age_valid)"}
